sources.study: A joint modeling framework for time-to-fatigue prediction with a single wearable sensor biomarker
reasons: The article explicitly says that RPE values were interpolated/imputed from the original 5-minute reports to approximately 2.5-minute sensor intervals.
The inspected compiled CSV contains an RPE such as 1.46153846153846. Integer or half-point values alone do not prove that a row is an original questionnaire response.
The original response timestamps or an observed/imputed flag have not been established. Do not recover supposed actual labels by rounding or taking every second row.
The other case study uses Borg 6-20 and its inspected compiled table exposes thresholded State/Fatigue outcomes, not original CR10 reports.
sources.license_note: No repository license was established in the inspected root/README. No model fitting or redistribution of a derived training table was performed.
